entity.name: Gökhan Çava
entity.description: Independent researcher building Atom Zero, an open-source local, source-cited assistant that runs on CPU.

projects.name: Atom Zero
projects.description: Atom Zero is a from-scratch 63M-parameter language model plus a local retrieval system. It runs on CPU, answers only from local documents, cites its sources, and says it does not know when the evidence is missing. Code and weights are Apache-2.0. The 1.8.0 release promotes the first 7B-teacher arm: 99.2% single-turn benign, 83.3% / 58.3% multi-turn, 60.0% 4-key copy (64.5% on a fresh unseen set), 40/40 safety, 16/16 self-harm and 100% on the local RAG suite. Every release, including negative results, is public.

plans.name: Monthly R&D support
plans.description: GPU compute for training and distillation, safety review, release infrastructure and a full-time maintainer stipend. Goal: $10,000 per month.

plans.name: One-time support
plans.description: Any amount helps cover a training run, an evaluation cycle or a release.
